s1_guidance_summary: S1: specific purpose as a clear question, higher-level purpose type, define terms, tie to key results graph, independent of Introduction, do not describe model
current_manuscript_location: Introduction para 4 (four questions); 2.1 'Method identity and scope'
missing_ecological_rationale: general purpose type (theoretical exposition/illustration) not stated; terms 'pays', 'survival' undefined
proposed_insertion: New ODD 1: purpose stated as test of whether habitat-deterioration vs movement-cost mechanisms produce a located S6/S7 reversal; define persistence endpoint
status_justification: questions exist but ODD purpose element absent and not independent

s1_guidance_summary: S1: qualitative but testable patterns used as criteria for evaluating the model's suitability for its purpose; for non-specific systems patterns can be general beliefs
missing_ecological_rationale: no patterns stated; no evaluation that model reproduces e.g. no-intervention decline, captive-only persistence with wild loss, post-release mortality excess
proposed_insertion: List general-belief patterns (P1-P4) and report whether reproduced from existing outputs

s1_guidance_summary: S1: kinds of entities, why included and why others excluded
missing_ecological_rationale: no rationale for nine node types or eight species; no exclusion rationale (no explicit landscape, no managers as agents)

s1_guidance_summary: S1: table of state variables with meaning, units, dynamic/static, type, range
missing_ecological_rationale: state-variable table absent; inert variables (foraging, wildness) and inert traits (climate_sensitivity, dispersal, social_dependence, connectivity) described as if functional
proposed_insertion: State-variable table marking used/inert; remove or label inert variables
status_justification: no table; description includes non-functional variables

s1_guidance_summary: S1: temporal resolution and extent, spatial representation, rationale for scales, separate paragraph
missing_ecological_rationale: no rationale for annual step or 100-yr horizon; space as non-spatial nodes not stated explicitly
status_justification: temporal stated, spatial and rationale missing

s1_guidance_summary: S1: hierarchy of actions: entity, submodel, state variables updated, execution order among entities; synchronous vs asynchronous
missing_ecological_rationale: state variables updated per action not listed; synchronous (vectorised) vs asynchronous (movement capacity) not stated
proposed_insertion: Rewrite Algorithm 1 as action list with updated variables and order

s1_guidance_summary: S1: rationale for included processes and for order
